paper_title: Sparse Hop Spanners for Unit Disk Graphs
classifications: Theory of computation → Design and analysis of algorithms
statement: 1. Are there point sets for which every plane hop-spanner has hop stretch factor at least 5? 2. Can our O(n log n) upper bound on the size of 2-hop spanners on n points in the plane be improved? Are there n-element point sets for which every 2-hop spanner has ω(n) edges? Recent results show that unit disks may exhibit surprising behavior [29, 35].
context: We conclude with two remaining open problems: 1. Are there point sets for which every plane hop-spanner has hop stretch factor at least 5? 2.
